info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — AI Assistant
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — AI Assistant.** AI assistant and provider gateway: chat and generation, admin configuration, budgets and usage, prompt library, consent, redaction, audit and MCP.
